task.title: Cosign OCI support
task.shortdesc: To sign and verify container images with Cosign in Red Hat Quay, you can install Cosign and authenticate to the registry. Cosign uses ECDSA-P256 signatures and Simple Signing payloads.

ul.li: You have installed Go version 1.16 or later.

context.p: Cosign is a tool that can be used to sign and verify container images. It uses the ECDSA-P256 signature algorithm and Red Hat’s Simple Signing payload format to create public keys that are stored in PKIX files. Private keys are stored as encrypted PEM files.

ul.li: Built-in binary transparency and timestamping service
